semantic_source_basis: Observation Schema v1 source map; semantic paths retained for v2 except independently versioned identity envelope
invariants: This matrix defines semantic eligibility and consumer intent only; it does not define tensor shapes, offsets, feature order, normalization, catalog vocabularies or encoders.
A candidate disposition is not a claim that the field is ready for runtime projection; all blocking conditions must be satisfied.
Action masks remain exact identity-correlated side inputs to Actor and Critic, never ordinary observation scalars.
Decision identity, payload hashes and catalog fingerprints are control/compatibility metadata, not learned scalar features.
Shadow recommendations, evaluator outputs, baseline recommendations, executor resolutions and diagnostic Unified Shadow state are excluded from PPO features and targets.
Missing, unknown, stale, incompatible and not-applicable remain distinct; no DTO/default zero or false is promoted to observed evidence.
Board, bench, shop, pool and physical unit/item instances retain distinct identity and ownership semantics.
Legacy offsets and encodings are historical evidence only.
